record.paper_title: Categorical Torelli theorems: results and open problems
record.original_question: Let X1 and X2 be prime Fano threefolds of index 1 and degree 10, also known as Gushel-Mukai threefolds, and assume there is a Fourier-Mukai-type equivalence Phi: Ku(X1) -> Ku(X2) between their Kuznetsov components. Must X1 and X2 be birational?

evidence.quote: Is it true that X_1 and X_2 are birational

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A prime Fano threefold of index 1 and degree 10 (a Gushel–Mukai threefold) is a smooth complex projective threefold $X$ with $\mathrm{Pic}(X)=\mathbb{Z}\cdot H$, where $H$ is an ample divisor with $-K_X=H$ and $H^3=10$. The bounded derived category $D^b(X)$ admits a semiorthogonal decomposition
$$D^b(X)=\langle \mathcal{K}u(X),\,\mathcal{E},\,\mathcal{O}_X\rangle,$$
where $\mathcal{E}$ is the restriction of the tautological rank-2 subbundle from the Grassmannian $\mathrm{Gr}(2,5)$, and $\mathcal{K}u(X)$ is by definition the Kuznetsov component, the right orthogonal of $\langle \mathcal{E},\mathcal{O}_X\rangle$ in $D^b(X)$.

A $\mathbb{C}$-linear exact equivalence $\Phi:\mathcal{K}u(X_1)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal{K}u(X_2)$ is said to be of Fourier–Mukai type if there exists an object $\mathcal{P}\in D^b(X_1\times X_2)$ such that $\Phi$ is isomorphic to the restriction of the integral functor $\Phi_{\mathcal{P}}(-)=(p_2)_*(p_1^*(-)\otimes \mathcal{P})$ to $\mathcal{K}u(X_1)$.

Question: Let $X_1$ and $X_2$ be Gushel–Mukai threefolds as above, and suppose there exists a Fourier–Mukai-type equivalence $\Phi:\mathcal{K}u(X_1)\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal{K}u(X_2)$. Must $X_1$ and $X_2$ be birational?
artifact.status_search_result: Work by Jacovskis–Lin–Liu–Zhang establishes a birational categorical Torelli theorem for Gushel–Mukai threefolds: for general ordinary GM threefolds (and in the mixed-type general setting), an equivalence of Kuznetsov components implies birational equivalence. The full statement without the genericity hypothesis does not appear to be fully proved.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems for Gushel–Mukai threefolds
status_evidence.snippet: Theorem 1.4 (Birational Categorical Torelli): Let X and X′ be general ordinary GM threefolds, and suppose that there is an equivalence of categories Ku(X)≃Ku(X′). Then X is birationally equivalent to X′.
status_evidence.claim: Birational categorical Torelli is proved for general ordinary GM threefolds.

status_evidence.title: Categorical Torelli theorems for Gushel–Mukai threefolds (MPG copy)
status_evidence.snippet: Birational categorical Torelli theorem for GM threefolds.
status_evidence.claim: The result is established under generality assumptions on the GM threefolds.
